I propose a 10-ton cap per fisher this month and whenever stock is 500. If all 25 follow it, 250 tons remain and stock returns to 500 under either replenishment outcome, yielding each of us $10,000 every month indefinitely. Larger catches risk losing that income stream. I intend to request 10 tons and invite everyone to publicly commit to the same cap.
